## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D multiplayer anime soccer game with Socket.IO matchmaking, a skill shop, server-side anti-cheat, and special admin privileges.

## Requirements
- Players start with 10 gold coins; skills cost 100 gold each.
- Admin account has effectively unlimited storage/coins, all abilities unlocked, and maximum stats.
- The user supplied a Socket.IO server example and explicitly requested “socket.io”.
- Build now without clarification; note assumptions briefly on completion.

## Objective
- Complete a playable 3D multiplayer anime soccer game with Socket.IO matchmaking, a skill shop, anti-cheat protections, and admin privileges.

## Requirements
- Players start with 10 gold; skills cost 100 gold each.
- Admins have effectively unlimited coins, all abilities, and maximum stats.
